name: Will Edmonson
tagline: Top rated General Litigation attorney in West Hollywood, California
education: New York University School of Law
about: In more than fifteen years of practice, Will has successfully handled litigation matters in a variety of industries, including real estate, technology, entertainment, financial services, and education. He has represented individuals and businesses (both large and small) in state and federal court litigation as well as mediation and arbitration. Will is especially proud of his record at oral argument on appeal.

Prior to starting his own law office, Will was a partner with Doll Amir & Eley LLP and an associate with the Los Angeles office of Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher LLP. Previously, he served as a law clerk to the Honorable Edith Brown Clement of the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit and to the Honorable F.A. Little, Jr., of the United States District Court for the Western District of Louisiana. Through the Los Angeles County Bar Association’s Trial Advocacy Project, Will served as sole trial counsel in jury trials on behalf of the Los Angeles County District Attorney’s Office. Each year since 2014, Will has been recognized as a “Super Lawyer” (2019-2021) or a “Rising Star” (2014-2018) by Southern California Super Lawyers .

Will received his law degree in 2005 from the New York University School of Law, where he served as an Articles Editor on the New York University Law Review and received the Vanderbilt Medal for outstanding contributions to the law school community. He received a Bachelor of Science degree in Business Administration from the Haas School of Business at the University of California, Berkeley in 2000. Prior to law school, Will worked as an investment banker. Outside of the law, he enjoys baseball (Atlanta Braves), football (Cal Bears and Atlanta Falcons), strength training, and detective stories.
